name: Interstate State Park, South Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split from 3291 2026-11-17. Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-17 at 45.3915,-92.6615 (300 m half-width), 45.3925,-92.6585 (550 m) and 45.3895,-92.6636 (230 m) - summer canopy hides the loop - and Esri Wayback 2016-04-13 leaf-off (release 9598, z18) at 45.3895,-92.6639, all rendered: one long loop running WSW-ENE over ~45.3890-45.3900, -92.6657..-92.6616 with two toilet buildings, matching the DNR South campground map (https://widnr.widen.net/s/5zcp7xjr5d/interstate_south-campground-map, sites 41-85, two vault toilets) and OSM's South Campground polygon. The Dalles Creek channel lies ~70-90 m north of the loop's north road through woods; the St. Croix is ~200 m west (OSM centerline 214 m from the loop) past woods; Lake O' the Dalles is ~600 m NE past the park road. No site within ~50 m of water over open ground -> not waterfront. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: WI DNR Interstate camping page (https://dnr.wisconsin.gov/topic/parks/interstate/recreation/camping, read 2026-11-17): 'The south campground and group camp are open throughout the year'; 'The south campground is available for hike-in, tent camping only from Nov. 15 through April 30'; 'No refunds will be issued for RV/motorized campers who make reservations for the south campground from Nov. 15 through April 30' (RV sites are sold there; RVs camp May 1 - Nov 14). DNR South campground map (https://widnr.widen.net/s/5zcp7xjr5d/interstate_south-campground-map, read 2026-11-17): a drive-in loop with sites 41-85, vault toilets and drinking water. The GoingToCamp fee panel read 2026-10-10 counted 54 RV-capable sites park-wide, more than the North campground's 35 drive-in sites, so at least 19 South sites take RVs. Own road off the park road, ~2 km (site-area centroids) from the North campground. Per-site lengths not read (GoingToCamp refuses automated reads).
note: The rustic campground of Wisconsin's oldest state park, opposite Taylors Falls, MN: one long loop in woods south of Dalles Creek, between Lake O' the Dalles and the St. Croix, on its own road off the park road. The electric North campground, about 2 km away, has its own entry. --Claude

sites.note: Sites 41-85, none with electric. How many take an RV was not read; the park-wide count implies at least 19.

facilities.note: Vault toilets and drinking water only. The showers in the North campground (about 2 km by road) are for registered campers, and the park's dump station is across the road from the Ice Age Interpretive Center.

season.note: Open all year, but Nov 15 - Apr 30 only for hike-in tent camping, parking outside the campground gate; an RV reservation for those dates is not refunded. In winter, water is available at the Ice Age Interpretive Center when it is open.

hookups.source: https://widnr.widen.net/s/5zcp7xjr5d/interstate_south-campground-map (PDF via the Widen preview: legend lists only Vault Toilets, Drinking Water and Recycling/Garbage; sites 41-85 carry no E mark, where the North map marks electric sites with E), read 2026-11-17

curation_note: Split from 3291 (Interstate State Park) 2026-11-17: the South campground is ~2 km from the North campground (site-area centroids), on its own road. No fees: the only rate read (GoingToCamp, 2026-10-10) was a park-wide range and GoingToCamp now refuses, so the South's own rates are unread. --Claude
